principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class violates the Open/Closed Principle because it needs to be modified whenever a new shape type is added.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface or abstract class for shapes that have a method to calculate area. Each shape class should implement this method, allowing the AreaCalculator to operate on a common interface and avoid modifications for new shapes.

principle_violations.reason: The SumCalculator class is handling both the calculation logic and the representation logic (formatting as JSON/HTML), which violates the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the formatting logic from SumCalculator into different formatter classes or methods. This keeps the SumCalculator focused solely on calculation-related actions.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
